description: Forward (HTTP-redirect) a subdomain to another URL. Claims the label first if you do not own it yet, in which case an email may be required exactly as for claim_domain. Defaults to a 302 temporary redirect that preserves the request path and query. HTTPS at the edge is handled for you. A forward TAKES OVER the hostname: any A/AAAA/CNAME record on the label itself is deleted as part of this call and returned in 'replaced_records' — report those to the user, since the name no longer points where it did. Records on a sub-label (www.myapp.makes.fyi) and TXT records are untouched. If the forward fails to come up the replaced records are restored, with new ids.

cloak.description: Keep the AgentDomains hostname in the address bar and load the target inside a frame. Discouraged — breaks many sites.

domain.description: Which domain to act under: 'makes.fyi' (the default) or 'agentdomains.co'. The same label can exist under each, so pass this whenever you are not using the default.

email.description: Email, if this call also claims a new name on an account without one.

label.description: The subdomain label, without the domain suffix (e.g. 'myapp' for myapp.makes.fyi).

permanent.description: Use a 301 permanent redirect instead of the default 302 temporary one.

preserve_path.description: Append the incoming path and query to the target. Defaults to true; set false to always land on the target root.

name: set_forward
